name: @mark1russell7/vex-mcp

tools.name: vex_catalog
tools.description: Gives each domain of @mark1russell7/vex-domains and each op: its call, its result, its lifting, its laws and its identity. Read it before a program uses an op, and before you write a host function for math.

domain.description: One domain by its import name, for example Vec2Domain. Without it, the tool gives the whole catalog.

tools.name: vex_check
tools.description: Checks a program as JSON. Gives its number of nodes, its nesting, the fields that it reads, and if the compiler gives it generated code. A program that is not valid gives the reason.

program.description: The program as the JSON form of the IR, for example {"tag":"app","op":"add","args":[{"tag":"ref","path":["n"]},{"tag":"lit","value":1}]}, or as a document of coeval, for example {"type":["ops","add"],"value":[{"type":"ref","value":["self","n"]},1]}

domains.description: The domains of the program, in order, by name (for example NumDomain or Vec2). The default is each standard domain.

tools.name: vex_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluates a program at each key of a space of records, or at each key of origins. Gives the value at each key, or the error with its code, kind, message and the path of its node.

program.description: The program as the JSON form of the IR, for example {"tag":"app","op":"add","args":[{"tag":"ref","path":["n"]},{"tag":"lit","value":1}]}, or as a document of coeval, for example {"type":["ops","add"],"value":[{"type":"ref","value":["self","n"]},1]}

records.description: A list of records (array), an object of records by key (record, tree, graph), or a list of rows (grid). A value of a domain is {"$vex":"domain","domain":"Vec2","value":[1,2]}.

parents.description: For a tree: the parent of each key, or null for a root

edges.description: For a graph: the keys that each key points to

space.description: The space: the records and their keys

origins.description: The keys to evaluate at. The default is each key.

domains.description: The domains of the program, in order, by name (for example NumDomain or Vec2). The default is each standard domain.

vars.description: The values of the variables of the run

tools.name: vex_explain
tools.description: Gives the trace of a program at one key: each node, with its focus, its reads and its result. Use it to find where an error starts.

program.description: The program as the JSON form of the IR, for example {"tag":"app","op":"add","args":[{"tag":"ref","path":["n"]},{"tag":"lit","value":1}]}, or as a document of coeval, for example {"type":["ops","add"],"value":[{"type":"ref","value":["self","n"]},1]}

records.description: A list of records (array), an object of records by key (record, tree, graph), or a list of rows (grid). A value of a domain is {"$vex":"domain","domain":"Vec2","value":[1,2]}.

parents.description: For a tree: the parent of each key, or null for a root

edges.description: For a graph: the keys that each key points to

space.description: The space: the records and their keys

domains.description: The domains of the program, in order, by name (for example NumDomain or Vec2). The default is each standard domain.

vars.description: The values of the variables of the run

tools.name: vex_module
tools.description: Gives the source of a standalone ES module of a program, without Vex at run time, or the reason that the program cannot be one. The schema gives the kind of each field and variable.

program.description: The program as the JSON form of the IR, for example {"tag":"app","op":"add","args":[{"tag":"ref","path":["n"]},{"tag":"lit","value":1}]}, or as a document of coeval, for example {"type":["ops","add"],"value":[{"type":"ref","value":["self","n"]},1]}

domains.description: The domains of the program, in order, by name (for example NumDomain or Vec2). The default is each standard domain.

schema.description: The kind of each field and variable: number, string, boolean, or domain:Name, for example {"fields":{"w":"number"}}

name.description: The name of the exported function. The default is run.

space.description: The space of the records. The default is array. The run of a tree takes the parents too: the position of the parent of each record, or -1 for a root. The run of a graph takes the edges too: for each record, the positions of the ends of its edges.

instructions: Vex evaluates one formula at each record of a collection, a tree or a grid. Read vex_catalog before a program uses an op. Test a program with vex_check, vex_evaluate and vex_explain before you write it into a project. vex_module gives a standalone module of a program.
